descriptors.name: connect.ws.ticket
descriptors.description: Build Connect WebSocket join metadata (URL + auth headers/protocol token).

token.description: Explicit token for the selected role.

token_app.description: Token alias used when `role=app` and `token` is omitted.

token_wallet.description: Token alias used when `role=wallet` and `token` is omitted.

node_url.description: Optional node URL; defaults to Host/X-Forwarded-Proto from the MCP request.

descriptors.name: connect.session.create
descriptors.description: Create an Iroha Connect session and return app/wallet tokens.

app_pk.description: Canonical unpadded base64url X25519 application public key (32 bytes).

nonce.description: Canonical unpadded base64url fresh session nonce (16 bytes).

node.description: Optional exact node hint included in both Connect deep links.

descriptors.name: connect.session.create_and_ticket
descriptors.description: Create an Iroha Connect session and immediately build WebSocket join metadata for a selected role.

role.description: Role used to select `token_app` or `token_wallet` for ticket generation.

app_pk.description: Canonical unpadded base64url X25519 application public key (32 bytes).

nonce.description: Canonical unpadded base64url fresh session nonce (16 bytes).

node.description: Optional exact node hint included in both Connect deep links and used as the ticket URL base when `ticket_node_url` is omitted.

ticket_node_url.description: Optional node URL override used only for ticket generation.

descriptors.name: connect.session.delete
descriptors.description: Delete/purge an Iroha Connect session by SID using the management token or an Authorization header.

token_management.description: Management bearer token returned by `connect.session.create`; the dispatcher maps this to `Authorization: Bearer ...`.

input_schema.description: Provide `sid` or `session_id`. The dispatcher still accepts `path.sid` and `path.session_id` for backward compatibility, but the published tool parameters stay flat for OpenAI-compatible clients.

descriptors.name: iroha.node.query_projection_checkpoint_plan
descriptors.description: Validate that uploaded shard refs exactly cover the canonical live query projection shard set and preview the rebuilt checkpoint (`/v1/node/query/projection/checkpoint/plan`).

emitted_at_unix.description: Unix timestamp recorded on the checkpoint descriptor itself. Defaults to the node clock when omitted.

shards.description: Uploaded shard references that must exactly cover the canonical non-empty live query snapshot.

descriptors.name: iroha.node.query_projection_checkpoint_publish
descriptors.description: Rebuild uploaded shard refs that exactly cover the canonical live shard set and persist the query projection checkpoint (`/v1/node/query/projection/checkpoint/publish`).

emitted_at_unix.description: Unix timestamp recorded on the checkpoint descriptor itself. Defaults to the node clock when omitted.

shards.description: Uploaded shard references that must exactly cover the canonical non-empty live query snapshot before the checkpoint is persisted.

descriptors.name: iroha.node.query_projection_shard_catalog
descriptors.description: Enumerate the live query projection shard catalog for one resource family (`/v1/node/query/projection/catalog/{resource}`).

asset_definition_id.description: Optional canonical or alias asset-definition selector used to narrow `asset_holders` entries.

offset.description: Stable entry offset within the canonical ordered catalog.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

descriptors.name: iroha.da.manifests.get
descriptors.description: Fetch DA manifest payload (`/v1/da/manifests/{ticket}`; `ticket`/`manifest_ticket`/`id` shortcuts supported).

descriptors.name: iroha.runtime.upgrades.activate
descriptors.description: Activate a runtime upgrade (`/v1/runtime/upgrades/activate/{id}`; `id`/`upgrade_id` shortcuts supported).

body.description: Optional activation payload. If omitted, flat top-level fields (except id/path/headers/accept) are forwarded.

descriptors.name: iroha.runtime.upgrades.cancel
descriptors.description: Cancel a runtime upgrade (`/v1/runtime/upgrades/cancel/{id}`; `id`/`upgrade_id` shortcuts supported).

body.description: Optional cancellation payload. If omitted, flat top-level fields (except id/path/headers/accept) are forwarded.

descriptors.name: iroha.ledger.headers
descriptors.description: Fetch recent block headers (`/v1/ledger/headers`) with optional `from`/`limit` query shortcuts.

descriptors.name: iroha.ledger.state_root
descriptors.description: Fetch execution state root by height (`/v1/ledger/state/{height}`; `height`/`block_height` shortcuts supported).

descriptors.name: iroha.ledger.state_proof

descriptors.name: iroha.ledger.block_proof
descriptors.description: Fetch block-entry Merkle proofs (`/v1/ledger/block/{height}/proof/{entry_hash}`; `height`/`block_height` and `entry_hash`/`tx_hash`/`hash` shortcuts supported).

descriptors.name: iroha.bridge.finality.proof
descriptors.description: Fetch bridge finality proof by height (`/v1/bridge/finality/{height}`; `height`/`block_height` shortcuts supported).

descriptors.name: iroha.bridge.finality.bundle
descriptors.description: Fetch bridge finality commitment+justification bundle by height (`/v1/bridge/finality/bundle/{height}`; `height`/`block_height` shortcuts supported).

descriptors.name: iroha.proofs.get

descriptors.name: iroha.gov.contract.get
descriptors.description: Read the governance binding for one contract address (`/v1/gov/contracts/{contract_address}`; `contract_address` shortcut supported).

descriptors.name: iroha.aliases.resolve
descriptors.description: Resolve an alias to its account binding (`/v1/aliases/resolve`).

body.description: Raw alias resolve payload. If omitted, flat top-level fields are forwarded as body.

descriptors.name: iroha.aliases.resolve_index
descriptors.description: Resolve an alias index to its account binding (`/v1/aliases/resolve-index`).

body.description: Raw alias-index resolve payload. If omitted, flat top-level fields are forwarded as body.

descriptors.name: iroha.aliases.by_account
descriptors.description: List aliases bound to an account (`/v1/aliases/by-account`).

body.description: Raw alias-by-account payload. If omitted, flat top-level fields are forwarded as body.

descriptors.name: iroha.contracts.code.get
descriptors.description: Fetch contract code metadata (`code_hash` shortcut supported).

descriptors.name: iroha.contracts.code.bytes.get
descriptors.description: Fetch contract code bytes (`/v1/contracts/code-bytes/{code_hash}`; `code_hash` shortcut supported).

descriptors.name: iroha.contracts.call_and_wait
descriptors.description: Call a deployed contract instance and poll pipeline status until a terminal state.

body.description: Raw request payload. If omitted, flat top-level fields are forwarded as the request body.

terminal_statuses.description: Optional terminal status override (default: Committed, Applied, Rejected, Expired).

status_accept.description: Optional Accept header for status polling calls (defaults to application/json).

descriptors.name: iroha.contracts.state.get
descriptors.description: Read contract state (`/v1/contracts/state`) using path/paths/prefix query modes.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.list

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.get
descriptors.description: Fetch canonical account detail from the same-route account read (`account_id` shortcut supported). Defaults to JSON; set accept=application/x-norito for typed Norito.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.qr

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.query
descriptors.description: Query accounts with filter/select/sort/pagination envelope (flat shortcuts supported).

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.onboard.plan
descriptors.description: Plan sponsored onboarding without mutating state. Send the dedicated token only as the outer MCP X-Iroha-Onboarding-Token header.

headers.description: Non-authentication headers only; the onboarding token must be sent on the outer MCP request.

descriptors.name: iroha.accounts.onboard
descriptors.description: Apply a stateless receipt returned by iroha.accounts.onboard.plan. The dedicated onboarding token is accepted only from the outer MCP request.

headers.description: Non-authentication headers only; the onboarding token must be sent on the outer MCP request.

descriptors.name: iroha.assets.definitions

descriptors.name: iroha.assets.holders

descriptors.name: iroha.assets.holders.query
descriptors.description: Query asset holders for one definition (flat `definition_id` + QueryEnvelope shortcuts supported). Supports exact aggregate DSL queries, for example PAYNET PKR alias users grouped by `primary_alias_domain` with `distinct_count(account_id)` and `sum(quantity)`. Production aggregate reads serve local DA projection shards as `query_source=projection_da_cache` and hydrate missing shards from approved SoraFS providers as `query_source=projection_da_hydrated`; incomplete projections return `projection_archive_unavailable` instead of scanning live holders. `live_debug` requires an explicit debug opt-in.

body.description: Raw QueryEnvelope payload. If provided, it takes precedence over shortcut fields.

descriptors.name: iroha.transactions.wait
descriptors.description: Poll typed pipeline status for an existing transaction hash until a terminal state. Defaults to JSON; set status_accept=application/x-norito for typed Norito.

terminal_statuses.description: Optional terminal status override (default: Applied). Include Rejected or Expired to inspect those failure outcomes.

status_accept.description: Optional Accept header for status polling calls (defaults to application/json).
